user.title: Connect GeoDrops to Google BigQuery
user.description: Paste your Google Cloud service-account JSON key and enter your GCP project id. The service account needs the BigQuery Job User role on your own project. New to this? See the integration documentation (linked below) for a step-by-step setup guide.

add_device.title: Add a GeoDrops probe
add_device.description: Enter the serial number shown in the GeoDrops app (for example AAA111) and a friendly name.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the GeoDrops service-account key
reauth_confirm.description: Google is no longer accepting the stored service-account key for project {project_id} (it was probably deleted, revoked, or its service account was disabled). Create a new JSON key for the service account and paste its full contents below. Your probes and settings are kept.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure GeoDrops
reconfigure.description: Change the GCP project the queries run and bill in, or paste a new service-account JSON key to rotate it. Your probes and settings are kept.

data_description.credentials_json: Leave blank to keep the current key.

error.invalid_credentials: The service-account JSON could not be parsed.
error.cannot_connect: Could not query BigQuery. Check the project id and that the service account has BigQuery Job User.
error.device_not_found: No readings found for that serial in the last 12 hours. Check the serial.
error.invalid_auth: Google rejected this service-account key. It may have been deleted or revoked, or its service account disabled. Create a new JSON key and try again.

abort.already_configured: This GeoDrops project is already configured.

add_device.title: Add a GeoDrops probe
add_device.description: Enter the serial from the GeoDrops app (for example AAA111) and a friendly name.

data_description.scan_interval_minutes: How often to query BigQuery for new readings. Default 20.
data_description.lookback_hours: How far back to search for each probe's latest reading on every poll. Default 12.
data_description.staleness_warn_hours: Log a warning once a probe's data is older than this many hours. Default 6.
data_description.staleness_skip_hours: Mark a probe's sensors unavailable once its data is older than this many hours. Default 12.
data_description.expire_after_minutes: Also mark sensors unavailable if the integration has not polled successfully within this many minutes. Default 80.

error.device_not_found: No readings found for that serial in the last 12 hours.
error.invalid_auth: Google rejected the stored service-account key. Update it via the integration's Reconfigure option, then try again.
